summary: A custom integration_config.yml tunes test parameters, and cloud tests run only when credentials are supplied per the cloud-config-*.template files.
questions: How do I configure credentials for cloud integration tests?

answer_card.title: integration_config.yml
answer_card.answer_md: Create your own `integration_config.yml` to tune parameters. Cloud tests run only with credentials; see the `cloud-config-*.template` files in `tests/integration/`.
